criteria.priority_notes: Standard Horizon Europe RIA evaluation criterion. Call-specific technical excellence dimensions signalled in the scope include: advanced planning, reasoning, and search mechanisms for AI agents; memory and state management architectures (short-term and long-term); integration of external tools and APIs; multi-agent collaboration frameworks; and multimodal reasoning capabilities. Proposals competing under the sector-specific portfolio exception (healthcare, advanced manufacturing, in-vehicle autonomous driving) should reflect sector-relevant technical innovation.

Specific threshold scores and weights must be verified against General Annex F and any call-specific evaluation guidance issued by the European Commission. Priority signals in priority_notes are inferred from scope emphasis in the source documents.

criteria.priority_notes: Standard Horizon Europe RIA evaluation criterion. Call-specific impact priorities include: contribution to the Apply AI Strategy; deployment via EDIHs; advancing European open strategic autonomy in AI; cohesion with ADRA and the GenAI4EU central Hub; and coverage of Apply AI sectors (healthcare, advanced manufacturing, in-vehicle autonomous driving) per the portfolio procedure exception.

criteria.criterion_name: Quality and Efficiency of the Implementation
criteria.priority_notes: Standard Horizon Europe RIA evaluation criterion. Call-specific implementation priorities signalled in the scope include: mandatory allocation of tasks for cohesion activities with ADRA and GenAI4EU; linkage to AI Factories and Data Labs; incorporation of KPI and benchmarking mechanisms; sharing of results on the AI-on-demand platform; and collaboration with relevant previous and concurrent funded projects.
